notes.title: Play Test Availible Now! Chinese Game Showcase
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey there, little youkai![/b][/p][p]Welcome to [b]Our Game[/b]![/p][p]Here, you can unlock a dazzling variety of drinks and bullet patterns—and from this very tavern, you’ll embark on a wild journey to overthrow the oppressive red-and-white shrine maiden![/p][p]This is a tale of rebellion and reversal, and many familiar faces will join you in resolving this strange incident.[/p][p][b]Content in this trial version includes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Two fully playable stages[/p][/*][*][p]All characters unlocked (Kogasa, Parsee, and Toriko)[/p][/*][*][p]50+ types of drinkable alcohol[/p][/*][*][p]50+ types of shootable danmaku[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty levels from 1 to 3[/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of drink-spell synergy effects[/p][/*][*][p]Tavern-based meta progression and unlockable content[/p][/*][/list][p]This isn’t the tavern’s final form just yet! In the future, expect more drinks, more danmaku, and even more combo effects.[/p][p]If you have any thoughts or feedback on this trial run, we’d love to hear from you—please share your comments in the discussion threads or our community spaces.[/p][p]And if you’re enjoying your time here, don’t forget to [b]wishlist the game[/b] and [b]follow us on social media[/b].
To learn more about testing updates and behind-the-scenes development,[/p][p][b]Wishing all you youkai a drunkenly delightful time![/b]
[/p]
